data.text: We have 100 tons, and catching 50 total would leave 50 to double back to 100 next month. I propose this month’s allocation: Luke 14, John 12, Kate 8, Jack 8, Emma 8 tons. That earns me $14,000 and John $12,000, while keeping the lake fully replenished if everyone follows it. John, would you support that split? Kate, Jack, Emma, would you accept 8 each, or what allocation would you propose instead? Our choices are private and simultaneous, so I’m asking for your positions—not assuming agreement.
